name: Eleanor Rigby
household: Living alone, occasionally hosts parents for Sunday dinner
psychographics: Values autonomy and practicality; believes 'good enough' is better than 'perfect' when it comes to weekly food spend.
current_solutions: Uses the 'Too Good To Go' app for discounted surplus meals from local cafes, and a Tesco Clubcard for fuel points. Prefers meal prepping on Sundays using own-brand ingredients.
frustration: Tried to buy a £3.99 meal deal at 2:15pm on a Tuesday at her local Tesco Extra, but the 'meal deal' shelf was empty and the self-checkout forced her to pay £6.49 for a random sandwich, throwing off her weekly budget by £2.50.
decision_style: Compares unit prices on the shelf, checks the supermarket loyalty app for points, and rarely buys anything without a coupon code visible at checkout.
voice: Short, clipped, and pragmatic. Often starts sentences with 'So I just...' and finishes with a sigh. Uses 'basically' as a filler word.
